organization.type: Federally Funded R&D Center Partner / University-Affiliated Research Center
organization.description: Helios ARC conducts applied research in trustworthy autonomy, secure software supply chains, and human–machine teaming for defense and intelligence sponsors. The consortium combines university faculty, cleared engineering staff, and transition partners for rapid prototyping through limited production demonstrations.

research_profile.research_description: The consortium operates integrated research threads spanning formal assurance, runtime monitoring, and red-team evaluation of learning-enabled components in representative mission threads. We emphasize reproducible benchmarks, shared evaluation harnesses, and publication of non-sensitive methods while protecting sponsor-specific data and models.

project_goals.primary_objective: Deliver a reference architecture and evaluation pipeline that enables assured deployment of learning-enabled components in mission threads, with measurable reduction in critical failure modes under adversarial and degraded conditions.

technical_goals.title: Assurance-aligned development workflow
technical_goals.description: Integrate lightweight specifications, property-based tests, and continuous evidence generation into the delivery pipeline.
technical_goals.success_metric: ≥90% of safety-critical modules covered by automated assurance artifacts in CI.

technical_goals.title: Adversarial and stress testing at scale
technical_goals.description: Operationalize red-team campaigns and robustness suites on representative hardware-in-the-loop configurations.
technical_goals.success_metric: Documented regression of high-severity findings within two-week sprint cadence.

technical_goals.title: Transition package for T&E
technical_goals.description: Produce playbooks, metrics, and training materials suitable for independent evaluation organizations.
technical_goals.success_metric: Successful dry-run evaluation led by external V&V without rework of core harness interfaces.

expected_outcomes.description: Repositories, containers, and documentation for reproducible benchmarks on public surrogate workloads.
expected_outcomes.transition_plan: Apache 2.0 release with sponsor-approved export review.

expected_outcomes.description: Methods papers and hands-on tutorials for assurance and robustness evaluation.
expected_outcomes.transition_plan: Venues aligned with program dissemination guidance.

project_goals.fundamental_research_justification: A substantial portion of the effort advances published science in assurance and robustness while keeping sponsor-specific data and models protected.
project_goals.revolutionary_vs_evolutionary: Evolutionary in platform engineering; revolutionary in the composition of formal, statistical, and operational assurance evidence for learning-enabled subsystems.

relationship_to_i2o_thrust_areas.alignment: Focus on trustworthy autonomy and evaluation under adversarial stress.
Secure software supply chain, CI/CD assurance, and compositional reasoning.

project_goals.competitive_landscape: Commercial ML tooling emphasizes throughput over assurance; defense programs need traceable evidence—our differentiator is integrated assurance artifacts tied to mission threads.
project_goals.transition_and_commercialization: Transition via reference harness, training, and optional licensing of hardened extensions to cleared integrators.
